strategies.name: S&P 500 (buy & hold)
strategies.blurb: The benchmark. Own the 500 largest US companies forever.

strategies.name: Small-cap value (buy & hold)
strategies.blurb: Tilt to small, cheap companies (factor premium).
strategies.risk: Market risk + long stretches of lagging

strategies.name: S&P 500 at 1.5x
strategies.rule: Hold 1.5x S&P exposure (e.g. 3 parts SPY : 1 part SSO, ≈ 1.5x).

strategies.name: 55% UPRO / 45% TMF
strategies.risk: Extreme: stocks and bonds fell together in 2022

strategies.name: S&P 500 trend filter
strategies.blurb: Hold the S&P only while it's above its 200-day average.
strategies.rule: If SPY closes above its 200-day moving average: hold SPY. Otherwise: hold SGOV (T-bills).
strategies.risk: Medium: cuts deep crashes, whipsaws in choppy markets

strategies.name: 2x S&P with trend filter
strategies.blurb: Leverage only in uptrends; T-bills in downtrends.
strategies.rule: If SPY closes above its 200-day moving average: hold SSO (2x). Otherwise: hold SGOV.

strategies.name: 3x S&P with trend filter
strategies.rule: If SPY closes above its 200-day moving average: hold UPRO (3x). Otherwise: hold SGOV.
strategies.risk: Very high: big gap-down days hit before the filter reacts

strategies.name: 2x Nasdaq with trend filter
strategies.blurb: Leveraged Nasdaq only while it's in an uptrend.
strategies.rule: If QQQ closes above its 200-day moving average: hold QLD (2x). Otherwise: hold SGOV.

strategies.name: Dual momentum (GEM)
strategies.blurb: Antonacci's Global Equities Momentum: US vs international vs bonds.
strategies.rule: Month end: if SPY's 12-month return beats T-bills, hold whichever of SPY / VXUS did better over 12 months; otherwise hold BND.

strategies.name: Sector momentum
strategies.blurb: Ride the 3 strongest S&P sectors; T-bills in downtrends.
strategies.rule: Month end: hold the 3 SPDR sector ETFs with the best 6-month return, equal weight. If SPY is below its 200-day average, hold SGOV instead.
